meta_data.base_class: retrieve the most frequent visitor within a specific <public venue> over a given period - these venues record visitor data and support visit frequency analysis.

tool_template.name: most_frequent_<class>_visitor
tool_template.description: Retrieve the visitor who visited the <class> the most within a given period.

start_date.description: The start date of the period, format: yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: The end date of the period, format: yyyy-mm-dd.

minimum_visits.description: The minimum number of visits to qualify.

include_special_events.description: Whether to include visits during special events at the <class>.

age_group.description: The age group of visitors to consider, options: 'child', 'adult', 'all'.

include_repeat_same_day.description: Indicates whether multiple visits by the same visitor to the <class> on the same day should be counted as separate visits.

return_summary_statistics.description: Indicates whether to include aggregate statistics in the output, such as average visit frequency or variance across all visitors to the <class>.
